title: A plan whose changes make sense
description: After a session you can see what is being proposed next and why the next step changed.

blocks.text: A completed session, a sense of how hard it was and a free day are different reasons to revise the plan.

quote.text: It started out great, but after about a month the distances started increasing faster than I could keep up. Despite providing feedback after each run by either putting "it's too hard" or "distance too long", the app just continued to ramp up quicker than I was progressing.

blocks.text: Store the fact of the workout and the feedback separately. Show the proposed change and allow a familiar session to be repeated.
An automatic suggestion should not hide what it rests on, or hand out one load as if it fitted everyone.
